name: Gresik
registryAssessment: Official national ATR/BPN BHUMI provides a public land-map viewer relevant to Indonesia and exposes parcel/land-field functionality, but this research did not verify a Gresik parcel response with a safe native identity. The official Gresik Regency GIS portal was found but its entry page requires authentication. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

queries.query: Gresik Indonesia official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the official ATR/BPN BHUMI public land-map viewer and help pages describing open spatial land-field information, plus the official Gresik Regency GIS portal entry page. No public Gresik parcel API or downloadable safe parcel geometry was identified in search results.

queries.query: peta bidang tanah Gresik resmi ATR BPN layanan peta
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI documentation stating that the interactive map presents land parcels/bidang tanah and supports parcel searches by NIB, HAK, or NIBEL, and found the official Gresik Regency GIS portal. The search did not produce a safe public Gresik parcel feature response.

officialSources.role: ATR/BPN national public land-map viewer documentation
officialSources.observation: Official help page describes the interactive map, spatial land-field information, coordinate display, and parcel search by NIB/HAK/NIBEL. It establishes a relevant first-party public map service, not verified Gresik parcel coverage or a returned feature.

Official documentation identifies land parcels, administrative boundaries, and land-value-zone data as catalog datasets and describes ATLAS as the underlying geospatial platform. No raw source attribute set was retained.
GET returned the official Portal Peta page with an authentication prompt ('Akses Sistem Informasi GIS'); no anonymous cadastral geometry or schema was exposed.

Official legal abstract describes a 2016 single multifunction land-parcel map initiative for Gresik and coordination with BPN. This is local administrative context, not evidence of a currently accessible parcel-vector service.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel identity and full parcel polygon were obtained. The exact WUP point was not shifted and no exact-point hit or non-hit was treated as citywide evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Indonesia ATR/BPN public land-map service and Gresik Regency GIS entry point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer/documentation presence verified; Gresik-specific anonymous parcel response, native ID field, CRS response, exact parcel containment, and citywide completeness were not verified.
